test_title: PYST 13: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: AKM is related to DNP in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, BTS is related to EWV. To which of the following is LGK related following the same logic?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/918843333299e0e30f75effe666076497fcd25d334efddceba4a228ed99387c8.png] ​

Logic: '3' is added to the positional value of each alphabet.

AKM is related to DNP →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35cc61d0904b9bf95476a83ddbbec64b79096a5ef86c75d448b6e70bd6fe472f.png] 

BTS is related to EWV →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e2c6d332c858dd386a4ab38179f42fa60d2cb3051efc5582b2f15e3bc361b71.png] 

Similarly, 'LGK' will be related to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72ad70e9100af87fd6e2334a3cf14c2670207919903adacc3daf4e391595180b.png] 

Here, 'LGK' is related to **'OJN'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
